about: Minimum pass rates for scripts/eval/ubunye-live-eval.mjs. A run below any minimum fails (exit 1), which fails the 'Ubunye eval' check. prices and dashes are hard rules (an invented price or a long dash is never fine). The others leave room for the model answering differently run to run. Holdout minimums were set from its first blind baseline; raise them as Ubunye gets better, never lower them to make a change pass.
holdout_baseline: 2026-10-17, develop preview, 80 x 2 runs, gemini-3.6-flash: type 76% (67 to 83), first 94% (90 to 97), says 88% (64 to 97), dashes 100%, cases 74% (66 to 80); every flagged price was a published price or a real price times a quantity. Minimums sit at about the low end of each range.
